user_runtime.latest_assertion: After the clip profile change, the reward particle effect is still not fixed.

legacy_baseline.transaction_scope: Direct presentation call only; no claim protocol or account mutation.

legacy_topology.composition_order: One particle scene is rendered into one clipped dynamic RT, then that RT is copied as N independent 2D images.
transform_layers: Inner effect_box keeps random scale 0.7..1.2 and random rotation.
Outer box follows scatter/flight and scales from 1 to 0.4.

unity_current_topology.display_copy_count: N wrappers in one shared full-screen RT
unity_current_topology.composition_order: N independently instantiated particle simulations are additively combined before the shared RT is presented to UGUI.
unity_current_topology.load_order: Each AddAsync is awaited before that particle starts its scatter animation.
unity_current_topology.transform_layers: Random initial scale and flight scale-to-0.4 are applied to the same RectTransform.
unity_current_topology.clip_profile: clipToRenderRect=1 is present but only restores the local visible boundary.

root_cause: The migration preserved visible count and later restored clipping, but lost the legacy source-to-presenter topology. Independent random particle sources, pre-UI additive composition, serialized load/start timing and collapsed transform layers produce a clustered effect even when each wrapper is clipped.
invalidated_conclusion: The previous conclusion that two 100x100 clip profiles were sufficient to fix ui_bangyu_1/ui_bangyu_2.
implementation_boundary: Refactor to one clipped shared dynamic source per same-resource batch and N independent 2D presenters; preserve separate inner random transform and outer flight transform, then compare the same temporal checkpoints and lifecycle counts.
